item.title: Kubernetes Blue-Green and Canary Deployment in Practice: Comparison of Three Deployment Strategies
item.description: In-depth comparison of Blue-Green deployment, Canary release, and A/B testing in Kubernetes. Step-by-step hands-on guide demonstrating instant zero-downtime traffic switching via dual ReplicationControllers and Service label selector swapping (apps: xiuxian -> apps: green), as well as phased progressive traffic shifting via dual-label design (business label school: czu and version label apps: v1/v2) and replica scaling.
